experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market, sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, grilled seafood skewers, and matcha treats from legendary local vendors. Engage with vendors who have operated their stalls for generations and discover the authentic flavors that define Tokyo's food culture.

experiences.name: Akihabara Tech and Anime District Exploration
experiences.description: Dive deep into Tokyo's iconic electric town, visiting multi-floor electronics shops, retro gaming arcades, robot cafes, and cutting-edge gadget stores. Experience the intersection of otaku culture and futuristic technology that makes Akihabara a global pilgrimage site for tech enthusiasts.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple and Asakusa Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Visit Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, Senso-ji, strolling through the Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional crafts and snacks. Witness morning prayers, explore the five-story pagoda, and immerse yourself in centuries of Edo-period culture and architecture.

experiences.name: Ramen Tasting Tour in Shinjuku
experiences.description: Navigate the legendary Shinjuku ramen alley and surrounding noodle shops to taste regional ramen styles including tonkotsu, shoyu, and miso broths. Visit acclaimed local ramen-ya recommended by locals, learning about the craft and regional differences that make Japanese ramen a cultural institution.

experiences.name: teamLab Borderless Digital Art Museum
experiences.description: Experience one of the world's most celebrated immersive digital art installations where technology and culture merge into breathtaking interactive environments. Walk through rooms of flowing light, digital nature, and AI-driven art that redefine the boundaries between human creativity and technological innovation.
